mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of a dynamic system where it influences and changes its environment (health, quality of life) and is being influenced by its environment (restructuring to provide new needed services)."

A hospital is an example of a dynamic system where it influences and changes its environment (health, quality of life) and is being influenced by its environment (restructuring to provide new needed services).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a system that interact with its environment exchanging raw materials and energy for services and/or goods produced by the system."
Open system is defined as a system that interact with its environment exchanging raw materials and energy for services and/or goods produced by the system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any system that continuously influences and changes its environment and is being influenced and changed by its environment."
Dynamic system is any system that continuously influences and changes its environment and is being influenced and changed by its environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system which is a part of a larger system."
Subsystem is a system which is a part of a larger system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a regularly interacting or interdependent group of items forming a unified whole."
A system is defined as a regularly interacting or interdependent group of items forming a unified whole.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are defined as a set of competitive activities which consist of strict rules to reach desired goals such as acquiring or improving knowledge and skills."
Educational games are defined as a set of competitive activities which consist of strict rules to reach desired goals such as acquiring or improving knowledge and skills.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of a subsystem in a hospital."
Information system is an example of a subsystem in a hospital.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a systematic process that involves communities and other stakeholders in an in-depth examination of their vulnerability, and at the same time empowers or motivates them to take appropriate actions."

Participatory Vulnerability Analysis PVA is a systematic process that involves communities and other stakeholders in an in-depth examination of their vulnerability, and at the same time empowers or motivates them to take appropriate actions.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a computer-aided application/software that is designed to engage, interact, and challenge user in a safe and fun way to learn the skills, knowledge or attitudes that can later be applied in reality."

A serious game is defined as a computer-aided application/software that is designed to engage, interact, and challenge user in a safe and fun way to learn the skills, knowledge or attitudes that can later be applied in reality.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a system with various levels of complexities."
The Health System is a system with various levels of complexities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the identification, formulation, analysis, and interpretation of outcomes to answer useful questions (Wilson-Grau, 2013)."
Outcome Harvesting Outcome harvesting is defined as the identification, formulation, analysis, and interpretation of outcomes to answer useful questions (Wilson-Grau, 2013).
